question.value: What are the morphology and kinematics of the 12CO(3-2) gas envelope of the Mira A+B binary, and what is the role of Mira B?

evidence.quote: We have presented a description of the morphology and kinematics of the gas envelope of Mira Ceti using high spatial resolution observations of $^{12}$CO(3-2) emission made by ALMA.
We consider here a set of observations (ADS/JAO.ALMA/2013.1.00047.S), made on the CO(3-2) line between 12 and 15 June 2014
made on the CO(3-2) line between 12 and 15 June 2014
The line Doppler velocity spectrum evaluated from 25 km s$^{-1}$ to 65 km s$^{-1}$ is available in channels of 0.4 km s$^{-1}$.
Observations of $^{12}$CO(3-2) emission of the circumbinary envelope of Mira Ceti, made by ALMA are analysed.

method.value: Gaussian fit to effective noise peak per velocity channel for 1''<R<7'' to get shift and width; sigma raised ~30% and shift by ~0.04 Jy/arcsec2 for R<1''; cut at 2 sigma

evidence.quote: for each velocity channel separately a shift $-\Delta f(V_x)$ and a width $\sigma_f(V_x)$ from a Gaussian fit to the effective noise peak.

key_parameters.value: cut usually at 2 sigma; results checked against 1, 3 sigma and no cut

evidence.quote: We have checked systematically that all results presented here are not significantly affected by a change in the cut level, or even by the absence of cut.

analysis_steps.goal: Characterise the bubble as an expanding ring

evidence.quote: If the ellipse is interpreted as the projection of a circular ring in space, its angle with the plane of the sky is $\sim$50$^\circ$.

findings_qualitative.value: South-western outflow is broad and expands at 5-10 km/s; north-eastern outflow has two blue-shifted arms around a dark region

evidence.quote: the north-eastern outflow consists of two arms, both blue-shifted, bracketing a broad dark region where emission is suppressed.

claims.hypothesis: Is the gas near Mira B bound to it or flowing from Mira A?
claims.experiment: Spectra, P-V diagrams and channel maps near Mira A and B, difference spectrum with symmetric position
claims.result: Difference spectrum peaks at 43.6 km/s, 1 km/s lower than 44.5 km/s, and is negative between 45.5 and 50 km/s
claims.finding: Gas flows from Mira A toward Mira B (WRLOF-like), with small possible bound contribution

evidence.quote: rather than seeing gas gravitationally bound to Mira B, we rather see an asymmetry of the gas flowing from Mira A

claims.hypothesis: Does the blue-shifted bubble trace a slowly expanding ring?
claims.result: Velocity rises from NE to SW extremity
claims.finding: Ring expanding at ~1.7 km/s, inclined ~50 deg, ~2000 yr old

evidence.quote: can be interpreted as the projection of a circular ring expanding at a velocity of less than 2 km s$^{-1}$

limitations_admitted.value: Lack of large-distance coverage prevents associating red-shifted arcs into spirals

evidence.quote: we are simply unable to unravel them with sufficient confidence from the present data.
